_comment: bonez write gate for Cursor. Copy to ~/.cursor/hooks.json (user-wide) or <repo>/.cursor/hooks.json (one project), then REPLACE /absolute/path/to/ai-plugin with your checkout — Cursor does not expand ${VAR} or ~ inside hooks.json, the same caveat codex/config.toml carries. bin/bonez-cursor-install.sh writes this file with the path already resolved. beforeMCPExecution prompts before the bonez `memory` and `rules` write ops (save/update/delete); reads (recall/list/get) pass through untouched. failClosed stays false so a hook failure can never block a tool call. No sessionEnd hook here: session capture is not implemented on the Cursor leg — see the README.
